indicators.title: Suicide rate
indicators.note: Intentional self-harm (ICD-10 X60–X84, Y87.0), standardised death rate, both sexes, all ages.

notes.SVK: Registered suicides in Slovakia are probably undercounted: forensic medicine records (National Health Information Centre) report substantially more suicides than death registration.
notes.AUT: From 2022, when assisted suicide became legal in Austria, assisted suicides are counted within suicide in the cause-of-death statistics, and the Eurostat figures very likely include them. Switzerland records assisted suicide separately, so the two are not directly comparable from 2022.
notes.CZE: Czech figures from 2024 (not yet in Eurostat) rise partly because of a method change: deaths are now checked against police records, which finds suicides previously recorded under other causes. Earlier years were not revised, so change across 2024 overstates any real increase.

England and Wales only (not UK), including non-residents; deaths by year of registration, not occurrence. ONS national definition: intentional self-harm aged 10+ plus undetermined intent aged 15+. Rate per 100,000 population aged 10 and over.

national.definition: Suicide deaths (underlying cause, intentional self-harm), both sexes, all ages, by year; ICD latest revision, exact codes not stated by KSH. KSH publishes no rate in this table. Cause-of-death coding changed in 2005 (break in series).
Intentional self-harm (ICD-10 X60-X84), both sexes, all ages, by year of death. Rate per 100,000 inhabitants. Data supplied to CSP by SPKC.
national.source: Central Statistical Bureau of Latvia / Official Statistics Portal

national.definition: Suicide deaths of residents, both sexes, all ages, by year of death; ICD-10 X60-X84 (euthanasia and attempts excluded). Rate per 100,000 mean population.

Registered deaths from suicide (death certificates, ICD-10 cause of death), both sexes, all ages, by year of death. Rate is GUS's published crude rate per 100,000 population (population re-based on the 2021 census from 2020). Not the police suicide series.

Registered suicide deaths of permanent residents, both sexes, all ages, by year of death; ICD-10 X60-X84, coded from death certificates. SO SR publishes counts only; rate is crude, derived here per 100,000 mid-year (mean) population from SO SR om7102rr. Registered suicides are probably undercounted: NCZI forensic reports counted about 47% more suicides in 2023 (see countries/SVK.md).
national.source: Statistical Office of the Slovak Republic (SO SR)

national.definition: Suicide deaths of residents, both sexes, all ages, by year of death (SURS 05L3010S, external cause 'Suicides'). Rate per 100,000 from SURS SDG table 3283804S (ICD-10 X60-X84, Y87.0; source NIJZ).

national.rate_type: crude, per 100,000, all ages (derived: summed age-group deaths over population implied by all-cause deaths and rates)
